summary: Setting history.persistenceMaxQPS to 0 (intended to mean unlimited) creates rate limiters with rate=0 and burst=0, causing massive error log spam (317K lines in 5 minutes) as every queue reader task submission fails.
userImpact: Users attempting to disable rate limiting with persistenceMaxQPS=0 experience catastrophic error log spam and performance degradation across all queue processors.
rootCause: NewHostRateLimiterRateFn falls back to persistenceMaxRPS() * ratio when MaxPollHostRPS=0; when persistenceMaxQPS is also 0, effective rate becomes 0, creating a rate limiter with burst=0 that fails all ReserveN(1) calls.
proposedFix: Handle persistenceMaxRPS() <= 0 in NewHostRateLimiterRateFn by using default value (9000) or returning math.MaxFloat64; add rate limiting to error log at reader.go:433
keyQuote: Setting history.persistenceMaxQPS: 0 in dynamic config (intended to mean 'unlimited') causes all queue reader host-level rate limiters to be created with rate=0, burst=0.
